full_judgment: 14. The prosecution upon which the burden of proof lies has not succeeded in proving the guilt of any of the appellants beyond reasonable doubt. We, therefore, allow the appeal and set aside the order of conviction and sentence and acquit them of the charges under the provisions of the President's Order No. 50 of 1972.
